independent_checks.command: .venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/test_experiment_sandbox_operator_acceptance.py -q --tb=short -k 'namespace or cgroup_counter or metrics_retain or dotted_cpu'

kind: Independent read-only profile-v4 namespace, bounded logging and outer-metrics review

primary_source.logging_verification: Separate logger/panic FD donation and internal-command stderr dup are independent of Debug; host log OpenFile accepts pipe paths without seeking. Actual routing is still untested on the worker.
primary_source.seccomp_verification: Pinned boot builder skips guest policy unless OCISeccomp is enabled and appends the compiled program before guest execution.

qualifications: Only stored fixture AST/policy and safe temporary-file/control tests run locally; no raw guest syscall, generated analysis, runsc or cloud execution by this reviewer
Logging conclusion applies after trusted boot logging initialization; faults before that point may still need independent host/kernel diagnostics
The generic pre-start client-sync EOF cause is not established by source review; actual diagnostic attempt is required without speculative quota changes
Guest filter enforcement/inheritance, ordinary numerical threading, readonly sealing, resource containment, controller death/recovery and release gates remain open until actual source-bound evidence
reviewed_boundaries: Guest OCI seccomp explicitly enabled; one masked clone rule per each of seven namespace bits prevents combined-mask holes; unshare/setns denied independently of arguments and clone3 returns ENOSYS
Trusted fixed mount/capability/identity operations and normal fork/thread syscalls remain admitted; raw guest compatibility and denial tests remain mandatory

Namespace fixture issues raw AMD64 calls only inside the future sandbox, checks zero capabilities, has immediate unexpected clone-child exit, distinguishes early denial from invalid-argument results, and includes ordinary fork/subprocess/thread controls
Exact fixed --debug=false, --debug-log=/dev/stderr and --panic-log=/dev/stderr route separate trusted boot diagnostics to existing bounded stderr without enabling debug stdout sharing
Existing adapter stderr capture is capped at1MiB, retained create-only with private diagnostics, and overflow/retention failure remains fail-closed with whole-cgroup cleanup; adapter source unchanged

Existing harness collector already reads outer cgroup independent of inner existence; actual kernel7 dotted CPU key is parsed with bounded keys/rows/uint64 and required-counter/duplicate rejection; raw per-job readbacks are retained before interpretation
No quota, original profile guard, C22 release, scientific approval or production-dispatch authority changes
